standardTerms: Stand By Time shall be billable for periods during which YMC resources are available for work, but unable to perform duties due to actions or omissions of third parties, client, or client agents

Work performed at the Client’s request on federal holidays will be billed at the applicable overtime rate. If no OT rate is specified, the work will be billed at 1.5 times the standard rate. All such work requires prior written approval from the Client
